responses: append complete serialized responses to immutable chunked JSONL
checkpoints: one validated assessment checkpoint and one completion-state checkpoint per chunk
resume: read manifest and checkpoints; skip completed request IDs; never overwrite or automatically retry
finalization: write final identity, assessment, and optional audit-only joined CSV only after all recipients pass
artifact_count_basis: per chunk: response JSONL + validated checkpoint + state checkpoint; plus manifest/config/schemas/final outputs/report
